rationale: Edge-case lens raised 4 candidates (one pair merged as the same preserve-hidden-value claim); all were verified against source and dismissed — the stale Task/Output Schema value on an in-panel custom-node-type switch matches the explicitly tested AC9 preserve-while-hidden design, and the mount-order-flash and liveCustomNodeId-staleness claims are unreachable given CustomTab's single-mount-per-selectedNode architecture. Acceptance lens found AC10 (regression test matrix) partial: CustomTab.test.tsx render-verifies Task-visibility wiring for only 2 of 5 custom node types, raised as CR-001 (critical, patch), which forces request-changes. Standards review passed cleanly with no coverage gap.

findings.title: Task-visibility test matrix incomplete for custom node types
findings.problem: CustomTab.test.tsx only renders the full panel for STATE_PROCESSOR and GENERATE_DOCUMENT_TREE; RESULT_FINALIZER, SUPERVISOR, and SUMMARIZE_CONVERSATION are verified only via CUSTOM_NODE_TYPES_USING_TASK Set membership in CustomNodeSelector.test.tsx, not through a rendered CustomTab.
findings.impact: The showTask wiring in CustomTab is integration-tested for only 2 of 5 custom node types; a regression in the wiring itself (as opposed to the Set contents) for the other 3 types would not be caught by the existing suite.
findings.recommendation: Add CustomTab render-based test cases asserting Task visibility for RESULT_FINALIZER, SUPERVISOR, and SUMMARIZE_CONVERSATION, mirroring the existing STATE_PROCESSOR/GENERATE_DOCUMENT_TREE cases.
